summary: Ran the first real end-to-end Stripe test against the new sandbox (acct_1UXmghB0mw23dZAJ, test mode). Every requested item passes. GET /api/plans returns 200 with the 4 plans at the right prices. UI flow: a new owner signs up, opens /app/billing, clicks Subscribe on Starter and lands on checkout.stripe.com (Link / managed-payments page showing '13 days free, then $249 starting Nov 16'). Paid with card 4242 4242 4242 4242, expiry 12/34, CVC 123 and a US address. Stripe sent us back to /payment/success?session_id=..., which showed "You're all set". /api/auth/me then had plan=starter, plan_status=trialing, a sub_ id, a cus_ id and billing_access=true. The Billing page showed the 'Manage billing' button, 'First charge on Nov 16, 2026' (billing-renewal) and 'Current plan · manage'. Clicking Manage billing opened billing.stripe.com with the subscription, the Visa ending 4242 and a $0 trial invoice. Real Stripe webhooks arrived within about 1 second and were stored in db.stripe_events (checkout.session.completed, customer.subscription.created, invoice.paid, invoice.payment_succeeded, setup_intent.*, customer.*), all returning 200. Pytest: 17 of 17 passed. They cover the double-subscription guard (400) on both checkout and checkout-bundle, bundle checkout (growth + 2 scribe seats, bundle_applied=true), an invalid plan (400), non-owner 403 on checkout, bundle and portal, an unknown session_id on /payments/status (404), a self-signed webhook with the new secret (200) and a bad signature (400), the expired account getting 402 while /plans still works, and vet1 getting 200. In the UI, the expired owner is redirected to /app/billing with the paywall banner and a 'Trial ended' badge. Subscribe opens a checkout with no trial that charges $499 today, which is correct.

minor.issue: No authentication. Anyone who knows a session_id can trigger a sync and read its status. The risk is low because session ids are unguessable and the sync only reflects Stripe's own state, but tying it to the user's clinic_id would be safer.

A Stripe Customer is created and saved on the clinic before checkout finishes. If the owner abandons checkout, the clinic still has stripe_customer_id, so 'Manage billing' appears even though there is no subscription. This applies to the expired paywalled owner too. Consider showing the portal button only when stripe_subscription_id is set, or creating the customer lazily.
left.days rounds down, so a brand-new 14-day in-app trial becomes 13 Stripe trial days. This is within the 13–14 days the request allows.

issues: The text says 'Your subscription is active.' even when the subscription is trialing and the first charge is in 13 days. Suggest 'Your trial continues; first charge on <date>.'
After subscribing, the sidebar still shows '13 days left in trial — Upgrade any time' even though the owner has already subscribed. It should hide or change once stripe_subscription_id is set.

action_items: (Optional) Show the 'Manage billing' button only when the clinic has stripe_subscription_id, or avoid creating the Stripe customer before checkout succeeds.
(Optional) Change the PaymentResult success text for trialing subscriptions, and hide the sidebar 'Upgrade' trial card once the clinic is subscribed.
(Optional) Scope GET /api/payments/status to the logged-in user's clinic.
critical_code_review_comments: stripe_service.py: checkout and checkout_bundle repeat the same session-creation and transaction-insert block (about 25 lines). Move it into a shared helper.
The status endpoint swallows StripeError silently. Log it.
The webhook ordering is handled: invoice.paid arrived before customer.subscription.created, and both synced correctly through metadata.clinic_id.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Stripe checkout end to end, portal, paywall redirect, expired checkout)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe checkout is a managed-payments (Link) page. To show the card fields, call locator('[data-testid=card-accordion-item-button]').dispatch_event('click'), because a normal click is intercepted. Then fill #cardNumber, #cardExpiry, #cardCvc and #billingName. Click 'Enter address manually' and fill #billingAddressLine1, #billingLocality and #billingPostalCode, then select_option #billingAdministrativeArea 'CA'. Uncheck #enableStripePass and submit with [data-testid=hosted-payment-submit-button]. Signup owners have onboarded=false, so set clinics.onboarded=true in Mongo first. The UI stores the token in localStorage 'vetaura_token'. The paid-owner tests in test_iter13_stripe_live.py read /tmp/e2e_tok and skip if that user is missing.
